# Model Mountain — contribution and evidence disclosure

The supplied v4 notebook and handoff predate this build session. Their embedded
security/RAG package, Streamlit dashboard, IBM MIA worker code paths, CPU fixtures and
behavior-vector lab are pre-existing components, restored as the baseline. The portable
Swarm hub archive is also pre-existing infrastructure. This work must not be represented
as written entirely during the hackathon.

New work is recorded by task, file scope and validation artifacts in the project-local
Model Mountain hub (16f864bfa1303fc9). The current build adds a Vercel web/control-plane
application, expanded remote model/MIA integration and stricter outcome-based evaluation.
Only finished and independently reviewed task results should be listed as completed.

AI assistance includes OpenAI Codex, Anthropic Claude (actual harness changes are logged
in the hub), and Google Antigravity. Model/harness observations are session-specific.
The team is responsible for understanding and validating generated work. No IBM Bob
usage is claimed. Third-party models, datasets, IBM vLLM-Hook/MIA and runtime libraries
retain their respective licenses and attribution requirements.

CPU synthetic fixtures establish software-path behavior only. Existing tiny hand-authored
cases are smoke tests, not population estimates of model security. Activation/emotion
directions are experimental statistical candidates, not evidence of subjective model
emotion or a universal security mechanism. Report real-model outcomes only from actual
held-out generation and genuine hook artifacts, including adverse and unknown results.
